newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens firm, focus on results, merger talk.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens firm, focus on results, merger talk.

text.p: UK shares crept higher at the open on Tuesday, boosted by a late rebound on Wall Street and lingering takeover speculation, but gains are likely to be capped by caution ahead of the release of the UK budget on November 26, dealers said.
At 0838 GMT, the FTSE 100 was up 4.2 points at 3,966.3, after the Dow, down about 12 points when London markets closed yesterday, pared losses to finish only 1.12 points lower at 6,346.91.
"We're so close to the budget, I don't think we'll do much. There seems to be a firmer bias," said one dealer.
